goal: Allow node operators on multi-homed machines to choose the local source address for outbound connections
Prevents the operating system routing table from automatically choosing the outbound interface
reviewability: Author has been silent for 89 days
New reviews may wait a long time for a response
agreement: Strong support for adding a dedicated option instead of modifying existing bind semantics (vasild)
Prior objections to altering -bind behavior were resolved by creating a separate option (luke-jr, gmaxwell)
Approach approval with open suggestions on tests, warnings, and dedicated source types (winterrdog)
Concept approval after startup address validation was added (frankomosh)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it gives multi-homed node operators control over outbound network interfaces
Solves a long-standing request from 2015 without altering core relay behavior or attack resistance
